declarations.docstring: A subsingleton Ext type from an extended module yields the corresponding subsingleton Ext type into a restricted module.
Extension of scalars preserves projective module objects.
A retract of the restriction of its scalar extension inherits any strict projective-dimension bound held by that extension.
Restriction of scalars preserves epimorphisms of module objects.
Restriction of scalars preserves a strict projective-dimension bound.
